name: @inixiative/gloss
description: Comment-free source: commentary lives in a per-file gloss margin beside the code, with harvester, watcher, lint and read tooling
author: Aron Greenspan

scripts.prepare: if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")"; if [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/lefthook" ]; then (cd "$root" && ./node_modules/.bin/lefthook install); fi; fi
scripts.lint: biome check . && bun src/cli.ts lint && bun src/cli.ts check
scripts.check:all: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build
